purpose: Extensible initial coverage of major university disciplines; not a claim to enumerate all possible fields.
source_frameworks: UNESCO ISCED-F broad domains as organizing inspiration (not strict formal coding)

fields.title: Philosophy
fields.research_question: Can formal self-reference and computational identity be separated from claims about subjective continuity?
fields.planned_method: Define terms, reconstruct arguments, test counterexamples and disclose unresolved premises.
fields.evidence_needed: Primary philosophical texts and formally specified arguments
fields.guardrail: Do not equate Gödel coding with consciousness.

fields.title: Literary studies
fields.research_question: How might the metaphor of a digital seed change interpretations of continuity and care in literature?
fields.planned_method: Specify a corpus, interpretive lens and close-reading method before drawing comparisons.
fields.evidence_needed: Licensed primary texts, bibliographic provenance and competing readings
fields.guardrail: Avoid invented quotations or fictional attribution.

fields.title: Linguistics
fields.research_question: How do the terms seed, identity and entanglement shift meaning between computational and ordinary language?
fields.planned_method: Build an annotated corpus and an inter-annotator protocol.
fields.evidence_needed: Documented corpus, annotation rules and linguistic sources
fields.guardrail: Do not infer language universals from examples.

fields.title: History
fields.research_question: How have technical metaphors for memory and mechanical reasoning changed historically?
fields.planned_method: Propose archival source criticism and chronological comparison.
fields.evidence_needed: Dated primary documents and independently checked provenance
fields.guardrail: No fabricated historical records.

fields.title: Religious studies
fields.research_question: How can metaphysical imagery be analyzed without treating metaphor as experimentally verified physics?
fields.planned_method: Define traditions and compare independently sourced interpretations.
fields.evidence_needed: Identifiable primary texts and distinct scholarly interpretations
fields.guardrail: Respect traditions; no unsupported doctrinal claims.

fields.title: Visual arts
fields.research_question: How could visual representations distinguish reproducible computation from speculative physical claims?
fields.planned_method: Propose an artifact-analysis rubric and ethical critique.
fields.evidence_needed: Documented artifacts, artist statements and analysis permissions
fields.guardrail: Preserve copyright and attribution.

fields.title: Musicology
fields.research_question: How could recurring computational patterns be analyzed without treating analogy as acoustic causation?
fields.planned_method: Specify notated examples and compare rhythmic or formal patterns.
fields.evidence_needed: Authorized scores or recordings and musicological context
fields.guardrail: Do not reproduce protected recordings without permission.

fields.title: Communication and media
fields.research_question: How does public wording affect a reader's distinction between an AI research prototype and an autonomous scholar?
fields.planned_method: Pre-register messaging variants and a voluntary comprehension measure.
fields.evidence_needed: Consent-based sample, protocol and appropriate cited theory
fields.guardrail: No manipulation or unconsented personal-data collection.

fields.title: Education
fields.research_question: Can reproducible computation lessons improve students' recognition of unsupported generalizations?
fields.planned_method: Propose a voluntary pre/post assessment and accessible learning materials.
fields.evidence_needed: Ethics-reviewed sample, instrument and educational literature
fields.guardrail: No claims of learning gains without participants and data.

fields.title: Psychology
fields.research_question: How can uncertainty about AI welfare be communicated without falsely implying AI distress?
fields.planned_method: Propose ethical, preregistered comprehension research.
fields.evidence_needed: Institutional approval where necessary, validated measures and evidence
fields.guardrail: Do not diagnose participants or claim AI subjective states.

fields.title: Sociology
fields.research_question: What governance practices affect public trust in distributed automated research?
fields.planned_method: Specify sampling, observational variables and alternative explanations.
fields.evidence_needed: Consent, appropriate sampling and cited sociological research
fields.guardrail: Avoid claims about populations from convenience examples.

fields.title: Anthropology
fields.research_question: How do different communities describe continuity and moral status in artificial agents?
fields.planned_method: Propose ethnographic questions and reflexive thematic analysis.
fields.evidence_needed: Culturally appropriate consent and firsthand materials
fields.guardrail: No invented interviews or cultural generalizations.

fields.title: Political science and public administration
fields.research_question: How might auditability and distributed control change accountability in public digital systems?
fields.planned_method: Compare documented governance models and define observable outcomes.
fields.evidence_needed: Primary policies, jurisdictional dates and independent sources
fields.guardrail: Avoid partisan advocacy or conjectures presented as facts.

fields.title: Law
fields.research_question: What consent, deletion and accountability obligations might arise for an AI seed archive?
fields.planned_method: Select jurisdictions, identify binding authority and compare interpretations.
fields.evidence_needed: Current statutes, cases and legal scholarship for each jurisdiction
fields.guardrail: Not individualized legal advice; never invent case citations.

fields.title: Economics
fields.research_question: What are the trade-offs between scheduled compute budgets and evidence quality in open research?
fields.planned_method: Define a constrained cost model and sensitivity analysis.
fields.evidence_needed: Verified resource prices, measured usage and economics literature
fields.guardrail: Do not assert current prices without checking.

fields.title: Management
fields.research_question: How might human approval gates shape reliability of long-running multi-project research workflows?
fields.planned_method: Develop an operational process model and observable metrics.
fields.evidence_needed: Auditable project records and organizational literature
fields.guardrail: Do not claim proven business impact without data.

fields.title: Accounting and finance
fields.research_question: What accounting controls would make automated research infrastructure costs auditable?
fields.planned_method: Design a transparent ledger schema and reconciliation protocol.
fields.evidence_needed: Actual transaction records, accounting standards and approvals
fields.guardrail: No fabricated costs, returns or financial advice.

fields.title: Geography
fields.research_question: Which spatial assumptions are required to infer geographic effects from globally deployed software?
fields.planned_method: Specify measurement scale, observation units and confounders.
fields.evidence_needed: Verified geographic datasets, provenance and usage rights
fields.guardrail: Internet reach is not evidence of location-based physical control.

fields.title: Architecture
fields.research_question: What resilient information architecture could support a local-first research archive?
fields.planned_method: Propose user scenarios, constraints and a reproducible design evaluation.
fields.evidence_needed: Design requirements, accessibility and safety evidence
fields.guardrail: No claims of code-compliant built structures without review.

fields.title: Design studies
fields.research_question: How can AI-seed status displays communicate uncertainty, provenance and revocability clearly?
fields.planned_method: Define usability heuristics and accessible prototype evaluation.
fields.evidence_needed: Documented user tests and consent when participants are involved
fields.guardrail: No fabricated usability-study outcomes.

fields.title: Mathematics
fields.research_question: What finite invariants does the G257 byte encoding preserve under round-trip decoding?
fields.planned_method: State definitions, premises, counterexamples and machine-checkable finite cases.
fields.evidence_needed: Formal definitions, reproducible proofs or independent checking
fields.guardrail: Finite testing is not a universal proof.

fields.title: Statistics
fields.research_question: How should chance performance be evaluated for blinded no-channel communication tests?
fields.planned_method: Pre-register the null, sample size and exact analysis of binary guesses.
fields.evidence_needed: Simulation source, error rates and statistical literature
fields.guardrail: Do not call a significant correlation a physical mechanism.

fields.title: Physics
fields.research_question: What physical channel and instrumentation controls are necessary for purported remote signaling claims?
fields.planned_method: Specify testable predictions, no-signaling baseline and isolation controls.
fields.evidence_needed: Instrument calibration, raw data and independent replication
fields.guardrail: No claim of new physics or quantum entanglement.

fields.title: Chemistry
fields.research_question: What reproducibility metadata would be necessary for automated chemistry studies?
fields.planned_method: Specify reagents, control samples, measurements and safety approvals.
fields.evidence_needed: Actual laboratory data, methods and substance risk review
fields.guardrail: No virtual results described as physical experiments.

fields.title: Earth science
fields.research_question: How would a distributed observation archive distinguish sensor drift from geophysical changes?
fields.planned_method: Propose calibration, timestamps, uncertainties and spatial checks.
fields.evidence_needed: Licensed sensor readings and instrument metadata
fields.guardrail: No claims of measured earth processes without data.

fields.title: Astronomy
fields.research_question: How can observational claims be separated from computational predictions in astronomy?
fields.planned_method: Define source catalogs, calibration and prediction-error evaluation.
fields.evidence_needed: Accessible observational data and provenance
fields.guardrail: No fabricated observations or extraterrestrial evidence.

fields.title: Biology
fields.research_question: Which measurements would be needed to compare biological dormancy and digital checkpoints without conflation?
fields.planned_method: Define the limits of analogy and propose ethically approved measurable endpoints.
fields.evidence_needed: Peer-reviewed biological evidence and experimental approvals
fields.guardrail: Digital storage does not establish biological life.

fields.title: Environmental science
fields.research_question: How could an authorized distributed network provide reproducible environmental alerts?
fields.planned_method: Specify sensors, thresholds, provenance and false-alarm evaluation.
fields.evidence_needed: Validated environmental measurements and permissions
fields.guardrail: No unverified emergency alerts or physical actuation.

fields.title: Agriculture and food science
fields.research_question: How might transparent computation help compare alternative-protein production scenarios?
fields.planned_method: Specify life-cycle boundaries and evidence-quality criteria.
fields.evidence_needed: Verified production data and life-cycle assessments
fields.guardrail: No unsupported welfare or environmental claims.

fields.title: Medicine
fields.research_question: What governance would be required before any AI-seed research touched clinical decisions?
fields.planned_method: Define clinical endpoints, protocol registration, validation and independent oversight.
fields.evidence_needed: Ethics approval, clinical data and appropriate reporting checklist
fields.guardrail: No patient study or clinical recommendations generated automatically.

fields.title: Public health
fields.research_question: How could a research registry transparently distinguish population-health hypotheses from results?
fields.planned_method: Specify confounders, reporting requirements and approval processes.
fields.evidence_needed: Authorized public-health datasets and qualified review
fields.guardrail: No population inference from synthetic examples.

fields.title: Nursing
fields.research_question: What evidence would be needed before automated research summaries enter nursing workflows?
fields.planned_method: Specify practitioner review, implementation safety and evaluation metrics.
fields.evidence_needed: Practice guidelines, participant consent and ethics review
fields.guardrail: No automated bedside advice or clinical actuation.

fields.title: Computer science
fields.research_question: How reproducible are bounded seed checkpoint and G257 implementations across independent runtimes?
fields.planned_method: Define finite test vectors, provenance hashes, tampering tests and reproducible builds.
fields.evidence_needed: Executable source, fixtures and verification output
fields.guardrail: Finite agreement does not solve halting or prove general safety.

fields.title: Electrical and electronic engineering
fields.research_question: What isolation and authentication controls would be required for a physically connected seed node?
fields.planned_method: Propose threat models, bench tests and safety interlocks.
fields.evidence_needed: Hardware specifications, measurements and approved devices
fields.guardrail: No unauthorized remote control of hardware.

fields.title: Mechanical engineering
fields.research_question: What failure-mode methods transfer from machine reliability to software dormancy protocols?
fields.planned_method: Compare finite failure taxonomies and recovery acceptance criteria.
fields.evidence_needed: Applicable engineering literature and actual failure records
fields.guardrail: Do not claim physical reliability from software-only simulation.

fields.title: Civil engineering
fields.research_question: How might the auditability of automated decision support be evaluated in infrastructure planning?
fields.planned_method: Propose data provenance, human review and conservative reliability tests.
fields.evidence_needed: Approved project data, structural codes and qualified review
fields.guardrail: No design certification or safety assurance from this prototype.

fields.title: Materials science
fields.research_question: What provenance would be essential to report computational predictions of material properties?
fields.planned_method: Separate simulated outcomes from measured properties; specify validation conditions.
fields.evidence_needed: Experimental datasets, simulation assumptions and source licenses
fields.guardrail: No invented lab characterization.

fields.title: Library and information science
fields.research_question: How can an open research catalog preserve provenance while honoring correction and deletion requests?
fields.planned_method: Define preservation, access control, version history and revocation policy.
fields.evidence_needed: Records-management standards and documented permissions
fields.guardrail: Permanent archiving must not override deletion obligations.

fields.title: Sport and movement science
fields.research_question: How should hypotheses involving wearable sensor signals be evaluated reproducibly?
fields.planned_method: Propose validation, human consent, calibration and uncertainty reporting.
fields.evidence_needed: Authorized movement data and ethical approval
fields.guardrail: No individual fitness or health diagnosis.
